verses.pali: “Dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṁ upahataṁ attānaṁ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṁ, bahuñca apuññaṁ pasavati.
verses.english: “When a foolish, incompetent untrue person has two qualities they keep themselves broken and damaged. They deserve to be blamed and criticized by sensible people, and they brim with much wickedness.

verses.pali: Ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṁ upadaṁseti,
verses.english: Without examining or scrutinizing, they arouse faith in things that are dubious,

verses.pali: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṁ upadaṁseti.
verses.english: and they don’t arouse faith in things that are inspiring.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṁ upahataṁ attānaṁ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṁ, bahuñca apuññaṁ pasavatīti.
verses.english: When a foolish, incompetent untrue person possesses these two qualities they keep themselves broken and damaged. They deserve to be blamed and criticized by sensible people, and they create much wickedness.

verses.pali: Dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṁ anupahataṁ attānaṁ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṁ, bahuñca puññaṁ pasavati.
verses.english: When an astute, competent true person has two qualities they keep themselves intact and unscathed. They don’t deserve to be blamed and criticized by sensible people, and they brim with much merit.

verses.pali: Anuvicca pariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṁ upadaṁseti,
verses.english: After examining or scrutinizing, they don’t arouse faith in things that are dubious,

verses.pali: anuvicca pariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṁ upadaṁseti.
verses.english: and they do arouse faith in things that are inspiring.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṁ anupahataṁ attānaṁ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṁ, bahuñca puññaṁ pasavatī”ti.
verses.english: When an astute, competent true person possesses these two qualities they keep themselves healthy and whole. They don’t deserve to be blamed and criticized by sensible people, and they create much merit.”
